summary: Capstone integrates D2.1+D2.2 across 5 stations with explicit predict-test-report cycle. Post-hoc prediction trap is a real Grade-1 misconception with concrete fold-over recovery and branching. Puppets explicitly optional with everyday substitutes. Worksheet has 3 parts but lesson runs 5 stations - minor station/part count divergence keeps consistency at 3 rather than 4.
